title: Ruthless Bar Salts Watermelon Sublime 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Watermelon Sublime offers a bold yet refreshing fusion of juicy watermelon and zesty lime, striking a vibrant balance between sharp and soothing. The lush, sun-ripened watermelon flavour delivers a fresh, delicate fruitiness, while the citrusy kick of lime lifts the profile with its zesty, mouthwatering tang. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is optimised for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, ensuring a flavour-packed vape with consistently satisfying vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction. Ruthless are one of the most influential brands in American e-liquids, known for crafting bold and unique flavours that have inspired the industry for years. Their expertly blended shortfills and nic salts continue to be a favourite among vapers on both sides of the pond who prize high-quality, distinct and flavourful e-liquids that push the boundaries of what’s possible in vape juice.
